span.p:
G1: all →ZH edges require a multilingual
Whisper model; an English-only (.en)
checkpoint fails the switch loudly and
the session stays put.
Reciprocal: set_stt_model refuses .en
while in a ZH state.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
cjk_reply: reply/announcement containing CJK
reaches playback while in EnVoice → auto-switch
(G2: on failure, that utterance's audio is
skipped, session stays EN).
G3 asymmetry: English text on a ZH voice is
spoken as-is — no rescue back to EN.
